issues.title: Backdrop overlay improperly scoped
issues.description: The dialog overlay dims only the left pane rather than covering the entire viewport.
issues.evidence: The dark scrim stops at the edge of the chat container while the dialog overlaps the drawer.
issues.suggestion: Position the dialog backdrop with fixed inset-0 over the entire viewport.
issues.triageNote: Not an alert-dialog defect: DOM probe on /eval/pair-108 (1024x768) shows the overlay is position:fixed, parent BODY (portaled), rect 0,0,1024x768 = full viewport, z-50, bg-black/50 — the suggested fix (fixed inset-0) is already exactly what the code does. Pixel sampling of the auditor's own archived screenshot confirms it: header/margins outside the chat container dim to 125 (uniform 50% dialog scrim) and the drawer sheet is dimmed to 127, contradicting 'dims only the left pane' and 'drawer un-dimmed'. The perceived seam (brightness step 125 -> 75 at the <main> edge) comes from the eval page composing ds:Drawer's own permanent bg-[#00000066] scrim (relative, z-50, scoped to <main>) beneath the full-viewport dialog overlay — a page-composition stacking artifact in src/app/eval/pair-108 (not editable), not a component bug. Same overlay verified full-viewport on pair-117 (390x844) and pair-161 (1440x900). No code change made.
